## Review type

Check all that apply:

- [ ] Code / layout / styling

## Checks

- [ ] I ran `./tests/check-site.sh` and it passes.
- [ ] I previewed the affected pages locally.
- [ ] Local links and navigation still work.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private participant data, or private locations.
- [ ] New images/media have permission/license information recorded.
- [ ] New or changed factual claims cite an appropriate source.
- [ ] Time-sensitive regulatory claims include the date checked.
- [ ] I have not presented unresolved project decisions as final.

## Reviewer notes

Call out anything that needs specialist or owner review before merge.
